landing.heroTitle: Code and chat with AI, in one ecosystem
landing.heroSubtitle: Qolari Code: a desktop AI IDE, paid with prepaid credits. Qolari Chat: the best models in your browser, by subscription. Transparent pricing, no surprises.
landing.feature1Desc: Qolari Code runs on Windows and Linux: AI agents that read, edit and test your code, with real-time streaming.
landing.feature2Desc: Pick Nexus High, Medium or Low per task — or turn on Nexus Auto and let the system pick the ideal tier for each request.
landing.feature3Desc: Chat with the best models in your browser, with history synced across devices. A simple subscription with a token allowance.
landing.feature4Desc: Prepaid credits for Code (12-month validity) and a monthly subscription for Chat. Pay in EUR, USD or GBP via Stripe.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Credit packages for Code and subscriptions for Chat. No hidden fees.
landing.downloadSubtitle: Native desktop app for Windows and Linux. Sign in with your Qolari account and start coding with AI.
landing.faq1A: You buy a prepaid credit package. Each AI request debits the exact usage cost. Balance expires 12 months after purchase.
landing.faq2A: We work with the best models on the market, curated and optimized by us. You don't pick models — you pick Nexus tiers (High, Medium, Low) and we handle the rest.
landing.faq3Q: What's the difference between Code and Chat?
landing.faq3A: Code is the desktop IDE for programming, paid with prepaid credits. Chat is the browser assistant, paid by monthly subscription with a token allowance. They are separate balances.
landing.faq4Q: Do I need a credit card?
landing.faq4A: Not to sign up. You only need a payment method when buying credits or subscribing to Chat (via Stripe).

marketplace.title: Qolari Ecosystem
marketplace.subtitle: Our product portfolio — built to scale, ready for market.
marketplace.ecosystemDesc: Each product targets a different market vertical but shares the same DNA: modern architecture, mobile-first, and built for growth. Together they form a diversified tech portfolio with multiple revenue streams.
marketplace.investDesc: We are open to strategic partnerships and investment rounds. Get in touch to discuss opportunities.

qolaridriver.name: QolariDriver
qolaridriver.description: A complete ride-sharing solution with real-time dispatch, zone management, fare calculation, and parcel delivery. Drivers bid on trips, users track rides live, and admins control everything from one panel.

qolarifood.name: QolariFood
qolarifood.description: A full super-app marketplace supporting food delivery, grocery, pharmacy, parcel, and rental — all in one platform. Vendors get their own panel and app, deliverymen manage routes, and customers enjoy a seamless shopping experience.
qolarifood.feature1: 6 business modules (Food, Grocery, Pharmacy, Shop, Parcel, Rental)

noaholive.name: Noah & Olive
noaholive.description: A marketplace connecting families with verified home care providers for elderly support. Features Uber-style cascading dispatch, geolocated check-in/out, execution reports with photos, Stripe Connect payments, and a reputation system.
